description: This file defines the 'ContactsViewQuickcreate' class which extends 'ViewQuickcreate' and handles pre-display logic for the quick create view of contacts within SuiteCRM. It contains logic to populate request variables based on the bean's address and phone data during a 'DC' form scenario.

classes.name: ContactsViewQuickcreate
classes.description: Class extending ViewQuickcreate to implement pre-display logic specific to the Contacts module, especially for DC forms.

methods.name: preDisplay
methods.description: Overrides the parent method to populate certain $_REQUEST fields based on the bean's properties during a DC form scenario.
